newsitem.title: CANADA: Plaintree sees C$0.30-0.32 Q3 share loss.
newsitem.headline: Plaintree sees C$0.30-0.32 Q3 share loss.

text.p: Plaintree Systems Inc said on Friday it expects to post a loss of C$0.30 to C$0.32 a share for its third quarter ended December 31, 1996.

The projected loss, based on preliminary financial results, is more than double the company's second-quarter loss of C$0.14 per share, but slightly below its 1995 third-quarter loss of C$0.35 per share.
Plaintree also reported an expected slump in third-quarter revenue to C$6.3 million from C$8.01 million in the previous quarter and C$8.46 million in the third quarter of 1995.
Plaintree officials blamed the results on "lower than anticipated sales" of the company's computer networking products.
Plaintree shares were trading up C$0.10 to C$4.90 in mid-afternoon trading.
